title: South Korea Nominates Han Seong-sook as First Female Prime Minister in Two Decades
detail: South Korea nominated Han Seong-sook as the country's first female Prime Minister in two decades, marking a significant political appointment following the ballot shortage controversy that overshadowed the June 3 elections. If confirmed, Han would become only the second woman ever to serve as Prime Minister of South Korea.

media.caption: Han Seong-sook nominated as South Korea's first female Prime Minister in two decades

title: President Orders Formal Investigation into Ballot Shortage Controversy
detail: South Korea's president ordered a formal investigation into the ballot shortage controversy, escalating the official response to the election irregularity crisis as public protests continue to demand a re-run of the June 3 elections. The ballot shortage at polling stations had raised significant questions about the integrity of the electoral process.

media.caption: South Korea president orders probe into ballot shortage issue amid election controversy
